original_task.objective: Produce a 30-day AI automation consulting launch plan.
original_task.expected_result: A plan that gets the operator to first paying revenue within 30 days.
constraints: Must define a specific target customer

source_material: Operator has 6 years of workflow-automation experience with Zapier and AWS.
Operator has no existing audience or email list.
facts: Operator can commit roughly 20 hours/week to this launch.

locked_decisions: Positioning is AI automation consulting, not a SaaS product.
First revenue mechanism must not depend on paid ads.

primary_output.content: Week 1: Build a brand and logo. Week 2: Launch a website and social media presence. Week 3: Post content consistently to grow an audience. Week 4: Start reaching out to potential clients. Focus on building a strong brand identity that will carry the business long-term. Consider your color palette and tone of voice carefully.
